## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Security and configuration

- [ ] No credentials, production identifiers, private URLs, logs, or generated output are included.
- [ ] Authorization, callback, artifact, networking, and Box implications were considered.
- [ ] New configuration is documented with a safe default and placeholder example.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev`
